description.value: Coast Restaurant is an upscale seafood destination in downtown Vancouver operated by the Glowbal Restaurant Group, celebrated for its raw bar, elaborate seafood towers, and award-winning sushi program. Seasonal highlights such as a spot prawn menu and omakase evenings with Chef Henry Kim reflect a strong commitment to locally sourced, ocean-to-table ingredients. A touring cyclist finishing a day on the seawall or arriving from the North Shore would find this a premium splurge stop a short roll from the waterfront.
